title: The direct image $p_*$ to the point
statement:
The *direct image to the point* is the functor
$$
p_*\colon\Sh((\Spec\Z)_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)\longrightarrow\Sh(*_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab),
\qquad(p_*G)(S)=G(\Spec LC(S,\Z)),
$$
given by restriction along $u$.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Continuous.lean:362 def sheafPushforwardContinuous : Sheaf K A ⥤ Sheaf J A; related declarations at lines 370, 377, 383, 393. Searched CategoryTheory/Sites. Read lines 355–372: continuity is the hypothesis at 356, and the body at 363–365 is lifted precomposition by F.op.
mathlib_searches.verdict: match: local source line 362 verifies the declaration and lines 363–365 verify every clause of the restriction formula.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: at line 362 (body lines 363–365), take F = u of def-sfb-profinite-to-proetale, A = Ab, J = the coherent topology on Profinite, and K = the small pro-étale topology of Spec Z; supply IsContinuous from lem-sfb-profinite-to-proetale-continuous. Thus p_* := u.sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab J K. The body is precomposition with u.op, so its value at S is G(u(S)) = G(Spec LC(S,Z)); on a sheaf morphism alpha it is alpha at u(S). No comparison theorem or extra hypothesis is needed. Lines 355–365 were read in the local Mathlib checkout.
